brief:
Standing before a sprawling canvas in her Bethlehem studio, fine artist Masada Sabat blends rich strokes of gold, crimson, and deep blue, bringing to life pomegranates, apple trees, and untamed waves, according to Palestine News Network. The compositions draw from Palestinian cultural symbols and landscape imagery to document her homeland's story.

Sabat works to carry Palestinian artistic expression beyond borders through her painted works, using traditional oil and canvas techniques to render the visual vocabulary of her heritage.

title: Bethlehem artist Sabat paints Palestinian heritage in oil and canvas
